entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. For sales, press 1. For technical support, press 2. For returns or order inquiries, press 3.
Please wait while I connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David, I'd like to start a return for my VeloBand Pulse.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your full name and order number, please?
Of course. The name is Anya Sharma, and the order number is VF-8675309.

Thank you, Anya. I see your order for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered on December 15th. To get started, can you tell me what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It’s really just a preference. It works fine, but the fit isn't quite right for my wrist. Now, I know it's been about 29 days, but I did try to return it much earlier, around my ninth day with it.
Okay, and what happened when you tried to process the return then?

I ran into a pretty significant website error. The whole returns portal seemed to be down. I kept getting a timeout message and I couldn't print the return label. I actually took a screenshot because I was worried this might happen.

I understand. Let me check our system logs for that timeframe... Yes, it looks like our whole system was down for maintenance that day, which caused issues with the returns portal. I sincerely apologize for that inconvenience.
Thank you. So, can we proceed with the return?

Absolutely. Just one moment while I check the policy for your item... Okay, I've pulled it up. It looks like you're well within the 90-day return window. So, we can definitely get that processed for a full refund.

That's great news. I appreciate you honoring that. Now, given the trouble with the website and the time I've had to spend to resolve this, would it be possible to get a small discount code for a future purchase? I'm a VIP member and was planning to buy some accessories.

Let me see... I do see your VIP status here, Anya, and you've been a loyal customer. We definitely want to make up for the system error you experienced. I can add a $25 credit directly to your account. Would that be acceptable?
Yes, a $25 credit would be perfect. Thank you, David, that's a very fair solution.

You are very welcome. I've just applied that credit to your account, and I'm emailing you the prepaid return label right now. Just pack the VeloBand in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once we receive it, your refund will be issued. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
